lines.zh: 灰翅膀贴着藤叶滑过去
lines.en: Grey wings slide past the vine leaves.
I fly fairly high in this wood.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的灰像蒙了一层粉
lines.en: My grey looks dusted over.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根垂下来的藤
lines.en: I swing around a hanging vine.
I fly fast, yet my turns are steady.

lines.zh: 我在花之间走了一条直线
lines.en: I take a straight line between flowers.

lines.zh: 光线从翅膀的灰里透出来
lines.en: Light comes through the grey of my wings.

lines.zh: 我贴着树皮飞了一小段
lines.en: I fly a short stretch along the bark.
My wingbeat is a fine sound.

lines.zh: 我一直往有花的方向飞
lines.en: I keep heading where the flowers are.
I fly out of the shade into the light.
My shadow wavers on the leaf.
I change altitude and fly on.
I skim over a fern.
My wings flicker between leaves.
I ride a vine upward.
I settle on a leaf tip, wings folded.

lines.zh: 我的灰色和树皮差不多
lines.en: My grey is much like the bark.
My gray wings are folded tight.

lines.zh: 藤蔓上有水珠，我没去喝
lines.en: There are drops on the vine; I do not drink.
My antennae sway slowly.

lines.zh: 一只蜻蜓飞过去，我没动
lines.en: A dragonfly passes; I stay still.
I angle my wings differently.

lines.zh: 这片叶子的味道有点涩
lines.en: This leaf tastes a little bitter.
I rest on a spotted leaf.
In shade my grey turns darker.
I coil my proboscis slowly.
Rain is coming; the wind cools.

lines.zh: 我在你面前的藤上停着
lines.en: I rest on a vine in front of you.

lines.zh: 我的灰翅膀你看不太清
lines.en: You cannot quite see my grey wings.
You blink, and I am still here.
I do not hide; I only keep still.

lines.zh: 你身上有花粉，也有一点汗
lines.en: You carry pollen, and a little sweat.

lines.zh: 我把一边翅膀抬高了一点
lines.en: I lift one wing slightly.
You come closer, and only then do I take off.
I circle once above your head.

lines.zh: 我把翅合起来，像一片叶
lines.en: I fold my wings to look like a leaf.
You looked a long while before spotting me.
A small corner of my wing is gone.
I land on a leaf, wings shaking.
Mud is on my grey now.
My wings tremble and I cannot fly steady.
I hide on the leaf's underside.
My wing edges have frayed.
I stop beneath a leaf.
My wingbeat loses its rhythm.

lines.zh: 我又试了一次才飞起来
lines.en: I try twice before I rise.

lines.zh: 我落在一片宽叶上歇着
lines.en: I rest on a broad leaf.

lines.zh: 虞美人的味道从那边来
lines.en: The poppy's smell comes from over there.
I taste the air; the direction is right.
No flower in your hand; I will not land.
The smell quickens my wings.
I settle on a petal, feet light.
I uncoil my proboscis and sip.

lines.zh: 再多一点，我就多待一会
lines.en: A little more, and I will stay a while.

lines.zh: 我绕着那朵花转了一圈
lines.en: I circle that flower once.
I set my feet on the petal.

lines.zh: 这一点就够我飞一整天
lines.en: This is enough to fly all day.
I knock into a leaf.
You raise a hand and I hit your finger.
My wing edge meets the vine.
I tumble into a fern frond.
Wing dust sticks to your hand.
I steady myself before flying on.
My big gray wings brush your hand.

lines.zh: 我被你的动作惊了一下
lines.en: Your movement startles me.
I turn a circle in midair.

lines.zh: 我落在你肩上，马上飞走
lines.en: I land on your shoulder and leave at once.

lines.zh: 一只灰的停在对面叶上
lines.en: A grey one rests on the facing leaf.
We keep apart and only look.
Her grey is a shade lighter.
She lifts off and I follow.
We round the same vine.

lines.zh: 两片灰翅膀在光里并着
lines.en: Two grey wings align in the light.

lines.zh: 我们一起避开一张蛛网
lines.en: We both avoid a spiderweb.
She stops, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我们翅膀的频率对上了
lines.en: Our wingbeats fall into step.
She goes first; I follow.
I land beside it, having no hands.
I touch it with one leg.
It is too heavy to carry.
I test it with my proboscis.
Not sweet, so I leave.

lines.zh: 我飞起来时它还在原地
lines.en: It stays put when I lift off.
I walk one circle over it.
I nudge it with a leg.
It leaves a mark on the leaf.
I forget it and fly off.
I check my wings and hover.

lines.zh: 我的灰色在光里不明显
lines.en: My grey does not stand out in light.
You take a few steps; I mark them.
I move to a higher branch.
I come up from under the leaf.
My grey pales toward the light.
I settle on the vine beside you.
You turn your head; I do not move.
I am waiting to see if you leave.
I fly half a circle and return.
I fly along your route.
You stop and I settle beside you.
I come no closer, nor go far.
My shadow stays with you.

lines.zh: 我一直在你身后那片叶上
lines.en: I stay on the leaf behind you.
Walk fast and I save my strength.
The vine hides me from view.
I fly along your shadow.

lines.zh: 你找不到我，我却在看你
lines.en: You cannot find me, yet I watch you.
I move to another vine.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，翅膀拍在你脸侧
lines.en: I dive and my wing slaps your cheek.

lines.zh: 我的腿在你手上勾了一下
lines.en: My legs hook your hand once.
I strike and climb away.

lines.zh: 我的力气只够拨动一片叶
lines.en: My strength could stir a leaf, no more.
I smack you with one wingbeat.
My legs catch your finger.
I bump your elbow.
I strike, then withdraw behind a leaf.

lines.zh: 这一点力气连叶子都打不落
lines.en: This could not knock down a leaf.
My second lunge comes in lower.

lines.zh: 我从一片卷起的叶里出来
lines.en: I come out of a curled leaf.
My wings dry faster than I expected.
I test my wings on the vine.
The light in the jungle is just right.

lines.zh: 我从蛹旁爬开，怕碰坏它
lines.en: I crawl from the casing, wary of crushing it.
I squeeze out of the leaf sheath.

lines.zh: 我的灰色一开始是湿的
lines.en: My grey starts out wet.
I wait on the vine for my wings to stiffen.
The jungle air is heavy and damp.

lines.zh: 我张开翅，量了一下宽度
lines.en: I spread my wings and measure their span.

lines.zh: 火的热气把我的翅尖卷起
lines.en: Heat from the fire curls my wingtips.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下去，翻着落
lines.en: I drop from the branch, tumbling.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被水粘住，挣不开
lines.en: My wings stick to water and will not free.
The blast slams me into a trunk.

lines.zh: 有东西从我翅边擦过去
lines.en: Something grazes past my wing.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的翅一阵发沉
lines.en: That force makes my wings heavy.
Fewer flowers, and my flight goes light-headed.

lines.zh: 雷光把丛林照白，我睁不开眼
lines.en: Lightning whitens the jungle and I cannot see.

lines.zh: 下面没有叶子了，我一直落
lines.en: No leaves below; I keep falling.
